newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Bosnian December retail prices up 0.4 pct mo/mo.
newsitem.headline: Bosnian December retail prices up 0.4 pct mo/mo.

text.p: The Statistics Bureau of Bosnia's Moslem-Croat federation issued the following economic indicator details on Tuesday.
BOSNIA RETAIL PRICES DEC NOV DEC 95
NOTE -- The data cover 51 percent of Bosnia-Herzegovina territory. No data are available for the remaining 49 percent.
Retail prices fell 22.1 percent in Jan-Dec period compared to the same period 1995.
Bosnia's 43-month war ended in December 1995. A sharp drop in prices resulted from a more regular inflow of goods.
